explanation: The theorem is a specific algebraic rearrangement of the resolvent: R(z) = (z−c)⁻¹ • 1 + (z−c)⁻¹ • ((A − c•1) * R(z)), where R(z) = Ring.inverse (z•1 − A). I searched the resolvent lemmas in Mathlib/Algebra/Algebra/Spectrum: resolvent_eq, resolvent_sub_resolvent, units_smul_resolvent, units_smul_resolvent_self and the mem_resolventSet lemmas. None of them states this decomposition, and none gives it by simple instantiation. The proof needs its own algebra, with Ring.mul_inverse_cancel as the only Mathlib ingredient of substance.
